text: ShadowLM moves one task off a rented frontier model onto a small model you own, without touching the agent.
A shadowLM runs in the frontier model's shadow on real traffic until it does the job as well, then takes over.
The capture proxy records an agent's real traffic into trajectories without changing the agent.
ShadowLM ships twelve training methods, from LoRA and QLoRA to DPO, GRPO, and MoRE.
The torch backend on CUDA is ShadowLM's production training path; mlx is the Apple-Silicon dev loop.
With ShadowLM the cost drops, your data stays inside, and the trained weights are yours to keep.
